change_log: decision_evidence_publication.py: seal_evidence and seal_evidence_with_run_slices now share one private _bound (replacing _captured_payload and _seal_captured); it decodes the capture, converts inputs to run-slice references only when a namespace is given, builds each route identity directly (same scope/execution/step_id/as_of/versions values as the former replace chain) and seals with schema_version 1 or 2. Error order kept: run-slice conversion before as_of parsing. _valid_slice_scalar inlined into slice_bytes with identical predicate. deduplicated_inputs no longer uses set.add (dict membership instead) so the pure core has no write-site match. compact_capture replaces every input via dataclass replace (equal values, identical encoded capture). bind_evidence and stored_bound_payload use conditional expressions; stored_evidence_payload pops inside the comprehension (same key order). Function docstrings became comments. decision_evidence_store.py: _check_record/_check_source_identity/_check_transform/_check_ic/_check_input/_validate_records folded into one _validate(value, adapter=_BATCH) with identical check order and messages; batch-only stage/route checks run only for DecisionEvidenceBatch, so decode_consumed_evidence reuses it. _json removed (_dump has a compact default separator); the nested timestamp default became module-level _timestamp bound with functools.partial. _records is an iterative preorder walk (same yield order). SQL text and parameters unchanged. decision_evidence_reader.py: _failure and _resolve_input inlined into _resolve_batch (identical messages and chaining); read_resolved_evidence only routes batches with run slices to _resolve_batch. read_decision_evidence stays a module global looked up at call time. decision_input_slice_store.py: _rebuild and _refusal inlined into _resolve/chain_length with identical messages; _walk loops on base_id instead of break; _row_digest inlines its canonical text; SliceResolver.resolve rebinds fresh caches on namespace change instead of clearing in place (not preserved: external references to the old cache dicts no longer see them emptied). _load remains a module global used by _walk. decision_slice_publisher.py: _referenced_id inlined into referenced_slices with identical message; row/retained build rows with inline expressions in the same evaluation order. All SQL statements unchanged. Deliberately not preserved: function/class docstrings (now comments, __doc__ differs; ConsumedEvidence/_Captured/SealedEvidence auto-generated dataclass __doc__), private helper names removed (_json, _check_*, _validate_records, _captured_payload, _seal_captured, _valid_slice_scalar, _failure, _resolve_input, _rebuild, _refusal, _referenced_id), none of which appear in the public surface.
